LINEAR context→answer map held-out R² SWEEP exists: #779 `eval_results/issue_779/fitter-fair-comparison*` (scaling_curves.json + n10k/n50k/n1m fits), dedup-audited by #1775. Qwen2.5-7B, layer 19, last-token input, ambient 3584-dim answer target, LMSYS(+WildChat) generic contexts, pointwise split, val-selected λ.

n_train → ridge R²: 250→0.558, 500→0.608, 1k→0.650, 2k→0.682, 3.6k→0.705, 10k→0.734, 50k→0.744 (deduped, n=47,704), 150k→0.754, 500k→0.761, 963k→0.754.

PLATEAU: n_train ≈ 10k–50k at R² ≈ 0.73–0.75. From ~50k to ~1M (20× more data) the linear curve moves only +~0.01. All plateau points are over-determined (n ≫ d=3584); the sub-d points (250–2k) are curve-shape only, not the plateau basis.

Contrast: the NONLINEAR (MLP) fitter keeps climbing to 1M (0.779@50k → 0.813@1M; deduped MLP-over-ridge gain ≈ +0.056 at 1M). Downstream MONITORING read did NOT improve past plateau even at 963k (#779: bottleneck is cross-distribution read-out transfer, not underfitting).

IMPLICATION for #2502 scale decision: the #779 plateau is a raw-COUNT plateau on GENERIC corpora — it does NOT bound the DIVERSITY axis this task targets (adding weird/OOD regimes changes coverage/OOD-generalization, a different axis than in-distribution R²). For a LINEAR map optimizing reconstruction R², ~50k contexts is the efficient knee; value beyond that comes from (a) breadth of distinct regimes/sources, or (b) nonlinear fits, not raw generic count. Recommend sizing #2502 by NUMBER OF DISTINCT REGIMES at ~50k–150k rather than 10^6 of mostly-redundant chat, unless nonlinear maps or an explicit diversity-vs-R² curve is the goal.
